_README: Stratified sample of a FRESH game-generated PGM3 league - no custom rosters, no games played. The full files are 3.3MB and 612KB, too big for project context. Every position x cohort and every staff role is here at min/median/max rating, so field COMBINATIONS and per-group shape survive. growthType is stripped from records (it dominates the size) - a few complete examples are in growthType_examples. For distributions, ranges and rules use the VANILLA_authoritative section of PGM3_SCHEMA_REFERENCE.json, computed from the complete files. Full attribute sets are kept on one record per position; the rest carry identity, contract, appearance and personality fields only.
